one_liner: Business messaging/chat app from Zoho with channels, bots, and integrations.

auth.evidence_quote: The first step in using OAuth authentication is registering your app with the Zoho API console.
auth.notes: Access tokens are short-lived (1 hour) and passed as 'Zoho-oauthtoken' in the Authorization header.

access.evidence_quote: you will get a Client ID and Client secret for your application
access.notes: Zoho API console registration is self-serve; Zoho Cliq has a free plan. Did not verify any admin-consent requirement for installing on other orgs.

api.evidence_quote: The Cliq MCP Server exposes Cliq's core capabilities as standardized tools, so MCP-compatible AI clients can read context, take action, and coordinate work across Zoho and third-party systems.
api.notes: Vendor-published MCP server confirmed via zoho.com domain page.

verdict.rationale: Self-serve OAuth2 app registration and free plan give a working credential with no extra gate documented.
